contexts.text: (Evil Spirits are held together in Societies) by being bound to similar phantasies and cupidities...
These more subtle evil Spirits also bind their ideas abstractedly to objects and things, but to filthy ones...

He bound Isaac his son () = the state of the Divine Rational as to truth, about to undergo the last degrees of temptation... That to bind = to put on the state of undergoing the last degrees of temptation, may be evident from this, that he who is in a state of temptation is just as if he were tied, or bound.
The bindings of the waters, and the clouds of the heavens () = the Word in the letter.
She bound double-dyed upon his hand () = that she marked the power... To bind upon the hand = to mark the power.
Lo, to each one the bundle of his money () = the orderly arrangements of truths conferred gratis. A bundle or bundle = orderly arrangement. Explained.
There were Spirits... who could flow deeply into the affections... They bound themselves to me so that it seemed as if they could scarcely be separated... Hence it was evident how loves conjoin.

It was also evident that when man is bound to Hell, he can never be set loose, except by the Lord through Divine means, as also was shown by those who had been bound to me through slight affections. I could not be loosed from them, except by means of intermediate loves, through which they were, by degrees, conjoined with others, and as they were being separated they appeared to be removed from me towards the left forwards; and the separation was observed through the changes of the state of the affections...
Under Donkey, see this reference.
Truths of faith bound to scientifics...
Their kneading-troughs bound in their garments () = the delights of the affections adhering to truths... To be bound = to adhere.
They shall bind the breast-plate by the rings thereof to the rings of the ephod () = the conjunction and preservation of all things of Heaven... To bind = conjunction and preservation.
To be bound and to hang = to flow in, for all conjunction whatever in the Spiritual World is effected through influx.
They appear to themselves... to have their hands and feet bound with serpents...
Under Society, see these references. HH 452. HH 481. HH 497. HH 514. HH 571. LJ 32. LJ 69:end.
Hence the man who is in evil is bound to Hell...
They call this being bound as to the very life, which is more intolerable than to be bound as to the body...

By the keys of the kingdom of the Heavens, which are that whatever this Stone, which is the Lord, shall bind on earth shall be bound in the Heavens, and whatever it shall loose on earth shall be loosed in the Heavens, is meant that the Lord has Power over Heaven and earth...
To open and shut Heaven, or to loose and to bind, thus to forgive sins, which is the same as to reform and regenerate...

And bound him a thousand years () = that those who are here meant by the dragon were withdrawn and rent away from all others in the World of Spirits, so that there should be no communication with them for some time.
This is the wisdom... with which marriage love binds itself; for it binds itself with it by this, that it shuns the evil of adultery as the ruin of the soul...
As there are such bindings together of goods and truths, the Lord says that the tares are to be gathered together into bundles to burn, and also all things that offend (; ).
The friendship of love tied with a man, irrespective of his quality as to the spirit, is hurtful after death. General article.
They are tied together interiorly as to the spirit, and cannot be rent asunder...
The punishment of tieing, Explained.

(Spirits) know how to bind themselves to a man by wicked methods, if the man be a Spirit in the other life like me; namely, by binding all things of the face, mouth, head, occiput, where the general sense is, entering into the ideas and binding, and this by various methods. Described. DMin 4596. DMin 4597, Explained.

At last he lost all capability of thinking, from which he appeared bound as to the hands and feet, and was cast down. The appearance of the binding of the hands is that he had no power of willing and thinking, thus none of plotting by means of deceit.
To bind hand and foot () = the taking away of Knowledges from the Word, through which he has counterfeited the spiritual man.
To bind and to loose in general, means to save.
To bind with cords () = to conjoin.
To bind into bundles () = to join together each species of falsities from evil.
